newsitem.title: CHINA: China approves new bank, credit cooperative.
newsitem.headline: China approves new bank, credit cooperative.

text.p: The People's Bank of China has approved the formation of the Harbin Urban Cooperative Bank and Zhenjiang Urban Credit Cooperative, an official announcement said.

The Harbin Urban Cooperative Bank, in the northern province of Heilongjiang, will be empowered to take deposits, make short- and long-term loans, organise domestic and international settlements, issue bonds and engage in other financial activities approved by the central bank.

The Zhenjiang Urban Credit Cooperative in central Jiangsu province will be empowered to take deposits from and make loans to collective enterprises and registered individual and privately owned enterprises as well as engage in other activities approved by the central bank, the announcement said.
